messages.subject: generating the .png files
parts:
Hi.

I've been trying to generate the name,chromosome,xresolution.png's with
chromosome explorer for every array and every chromosome using a linux
server. I managed to do it once but I can't do it again.

After these instructions
glad =GladModel(cesN)
ce <- ChromosomeExplorer(glad),

I've tried:

process(ce, verbose=verbose)
process(ce, array =c(1,2),chromosome=c(1:24), verbose=verbose)

plot(glad, chromosomes=c(1:24),arrays=c(1:2)).

During the process I get messages of this sort:

20080521 11:47:48| Calling onFit.CopyNumberSegmentationModel() hooks...
20080521 11:47:48| Plotting KHA212008-6 for chromosome 21 [46.98MB]...
20080521 11:47:48| Pathname:
reports/PruebaSNP6/ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B,FLN,-XY/GenomeWideSNP_6/glad/KHA212008-6,chr21,x0001.png
20080521 11:47:48| Dimensions: 241x400
20080521 11:47:48| Ticks by: 1.000000
20080521 11:47:48| Plotting graph...
20080521 11:47:48| Plotting graph...done
20080521 11:47:48| Pathname:
reports/PruebaSNP6/ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B,FLN,-XY/GenomeWideSNP_6/glad/KHA212008-6,chr21,x0002.png
20080521 11:47:48| Dimensions: 382x400
20080521 11:47:48| Ticks by: 1.000000
20080521 11:47:48| Plotting graph...
20080521 11:47:49| Plotting graph...done
20080521 11:47:49| Pathname:
reports/PruebaSNP6/ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B,FLN,-XY/GenomeWideSNP_6/glad/KHA212008-6,chr21,x0004.png

but when the process is finished and I go to the /reports directory the
only file I find there is regions.xls.

Does anyone know why this might be happening?

Thanks in advance,
Valeria
